purpose: Independent practice of B1.2 (compare to 1000) and B1.4 (skip-count to 1000).
student_learning_goal: I can compare and order numbers to 1000 using place-value reasoning and count to 1000 by 50s, 100s, and 200s.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can compare and order numbers to 1000 using place-value reasoning and count to 1000 by 50s, 100s, and 200s.
header.character_watermark: Penny the Place Value Pal in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Compare each pair. Write > for greater than, < for less than. Then write WHY using the place-value rule.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Six comparison rows.

image_placeholders.description: Six comparison rows in B&W line-art, stacked vertically. Each row ~7in × 0.7in. Format: number boxes on each side, > / < bubbles in the middle, 'Why?' line below. Pairs: 347 vs 374, 562 vs 526, 999 vs 1000, 234 vs 432, 700 vs 70, 178 vs 187.
image_placeholders.placement: Top of the page; six rows.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_SIX_COMPARES: keywords (compare, place-value) name what the rows show.

parts.answer_key: 347 < 374 (same hundreds, 4 vs 7 tens). 562 > 526 (same hundreds, 6 vs 2 tens). 999 < 1000 (0 thousand vs 1 thousand). 234 < 432 (2 vs 4 hundreds). 700 > 70 (7 hundreds vs 0 hundreds). 178 < 187 (same hundreds, 7 vs 8 tens).

parts.student_instructions: Three Number Lines. Fill in the missing numbers.
parts.visual_layout: Middle. Three Number Line strips stacked.

image_placeholders.description: Three horizontal Number Line strips in B&W line-art, stacked vertically. Each ~7in × 0.8in. Strip 1: cell 1 shows '0', label 'by 50s, end at 500'. Strip 2: cell 1 shows '0', label 'by 100s, end at 1000'. Strip 3: cell 1 shows '0', label 'by 200s, end at 1000'. End cells pre-filled.
image_placeholders.placement: Middle of the page; three strips.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_THREE_LINES: keywords (number-line, skip-count) name what the lines show.

parts.student_instructions: Order these FRESH numbers from smallest to largest: 405, 67, 999, 250, 712.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom. Five number cards plus five empty ordering boxes with arrows.

image_placeholders.description: An ordering layout in B&W line-art, ~7in × 2.5in. Five number cards on the left in random order: 234, 567, 89, 800, 142. Five empty boxes in a row on the right with right-arrows between them, labeled 'smallest to biggest'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_ORDER: keywords (order, smallest) name what the layout asks for.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write THREE comparisons of your own using numbers between 100 and 1000.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Use Part 1's 999-vs-1000 row as the strongest test of cross-thousand comparison reasoning. Watch for Part 2 Strip 3 (count by 200s) — children who default to 100s lose track at step 3. Part 3 swapped to 5 unfamiliar numbers (405, 67, 999, 250, 712) — verifies place-value comparison transfers.
